name: Core
description: Administrative module handling user management, role definition, module administration, and system configuration.

name: Default
description: Base module providing authentication, global search, tagging, file upload handling, and standardized CRUD operations.

name: Project
description: Project management module implementing hierarchical project structures with permissions and tree operations.

name: Calendar2
description: Calendar module with scheduling capabilities, recurring events, and CalDAV synchronization support.

name: Timecard
description: Time tracking module enabling project time logging, vacation management, and timesheet reporting.

name: Phprojekt
description: Core framework library providing Active Record ORM, controllers, models, and infrastructure services.

name: ActiveRecord
description: Active Record implementation providing ORM capabilities with relationship mapping and lifecycle hooks.

name: Auth
description: Authentication system managing user sessions, credential validation, and identity resolution.

name: User
description: User management library handling user models, settings, and profile information.

name: Role
description: Role-based access control library managing roles and module permissions.

name: Search
description: Full-text search engine providing indexing and search capabilities across all modules.

name: Tree
description: Hierarchical tree structure library for managing nested data like project hierarchies.

name: Notification
description: Notification system delivering messages via email and frontend channels.

name: DatabaseManager
description: Database schema management handling migrations, table creation, and schema inspection.

name: Migration
description: Database migration system managing schema versioning and upgrades.

name: CalDAV
description: CalDAV protocol implementation enabling calendar synchronization with external clients.

name: Converter
description: Data conversion utilities for transforming between formats like JSON, CSV, and internal representations.

name: Exception
description: Exception hierarchy providing specialized exception types for various error conditions.

name: Filter
description: Input filtering and tokenization for search queries and data validation.

name: Model
description: Model utilities for data conversion and validation across the application.

name: Pdf
description: PDF generation library for creating reports and document exports.

name: Setup
description: Installation and configuration module for initial system setup and database initialization.

name: HTMLPurifier
description: HTML sanitization library providing XSS protection for user-generated content.

name: Cleaner
description: Data cleaning and maintenance utilities for database operations.
